cards.ex: Bear with me while I try to fix this glitch; it might take a few minutes.
cards.exUz: Men bu nosozlikni tuzatishga urinayotganimda sabr qiling; bu bir necha daqiqa vaqt olishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Bir oz sabr qiling, chunki men biroz vaqt talab qiladigan ish qilyapman.

cards.ex: After hours of dealing with customer complaints, I was really fraying at the edges.
cards.exUz: Mijozlarning shikoyatlarini soatlab ko'rib chiqqanimdan so'ng, men haqiqatan ham asabiylashdim.
cards.uzDef: Sabri tugayotgan, asabi buzilayotgan holat.

cards.ex: The kids started to get antsy during the long car ride.
cards.exUz: Bolalar uzoq mashina haydash paytida bezovta bo'lishni boshladilar.
cards.uzDef: Intizorlikdan yoki zerikishdan bezovta bo'lish.

cards.ex: Don't worry, everything will fall into place in due time.
cards.exUz: Xavotir olmang, vaqti kelganda hamma narsa o'z o'rniga tushadi.
cards.uzDef: Kerakli vaqt kelganda; vaqti-soati yetganda.

cards.ex: She agreed to help, but with gritted teeth, it was clear she wasn't happy about it.
cards.exUz: U yordam berishga rozi bo'ldi, lekin tishini g'ijirlatib, bundan xursand emasligi aniq edi.
cards.uzDef: G'azabni yoki og'riqni yashirib, tishlarini qisib.

cards.ex: I'm running out of patience with his excuses; I need to see some results.
cards.exUz: Uning bahonalariga sabrim tugamoqda; men natijalarni ko'rishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Sabri kamayib, asabiylashishga yaqinlashmoq.

cards.ex: Waiting in line for hours was a real test of endurance.
cards.exUz: Soatlab navbatda turish haqiqiy bardosh sinovi edi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt davomida qiyinchilikka bardosh berishni talab qiladigan narsa.

cards.ex: I was on pins and needles waiting for the test results.
cards.exUz: Men test natijalarini kutishdan juda xavotirda edim.
cards.uzDef: Nimanidir kutishdan yoki xavotirlanishdan juda asabiy bo'lish.

cards.ex: If push comes to shove, I can always borrow money from my parents.
cards.exUz: Agar vaziyat juda jiddiylashsa, men har doim ota-onamdan pul qarz olsam bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Agar vaziyat juda qiyin bo'lsa, eng yomon holatda.

cards.ex: His rude comment was the last straw; I quit the project.
cards.exUz: Uning qo'pol izohi oxirgi tomchi bo'ldi; men loyihani tark etdim.
cards.uzDef: Sabr kosasini to'ldiradigan oxirgi muammo yoki voqea.

cards.ex: We just need to hold out a little longer until help arrives.
cards.exUz: Yordam kelguncha biz biroz ko'proq bardosh berishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatga bardosh berish, taslim bo'lmaslik.

cards.ex: I hate going to the dentist, but I'll just have to bite the bullet and go.
cards.exUz: Men tish shifokoriga borishni yomon ko'raman, lekin men chidashim kerak va borishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yoqimsiz narsani sabr bilan qabul qilish.

cards.ex: That noise is really on my last nerve; can you please turn it off?
cards.exUz: Bu shovqin meni juda asabiylashtirmoqda; iltimos, uni o'chirasizmi?
cards.uzDef: Juda asabiylashgan, sabrning chegarasida.

cards.ex: He's a bit short-tempered in the mornings before he's had his coffee.
cards.exUz: U ertalab, qahva ichishdan oldin biroz jahldor.
cards.uzDef: Tez asabiylashadigan odam.

cards.ex: Don't give up; perseverance pays off in the end.
cards.exUz: Taslim bo'lmang; qattiq mehnat oxirida o'zini oqlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklarga qaramay davom etish oxir-oqibat muvaffaqiyatga olib keladi.

cards.ex: Even during the crisis, she remained as cool as a cucumber.
cards.exUz: Hatto inqiroz paytida ham u xotirjamligicha qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Juda xotirjam, hech qanday asabiylik yo'q.

cards.ex: He had a complete meltdown after losing his job.
cards.exUz: U ishdan bo'shatilgandan so'ng asab buzilishi bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Katta stress tufayli emotsional nazoratni yo'qotish.

cards.ex: The principles of good design should withstand the test of time.
cards.exUz: Yaxshi dizayn tamoyillari vaqt sinovidan o'tishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt o'tishi bilan yaxshi holatda qolish.

cards.ex: Just relax and don't keep checking the oven; a watched pot never boils.
cards.exUz: Shunchaki dam oling va pechni tekshirishni to'xtating; shoshilsang ish bitmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Nimanidir kutayotganda unga e'tibor qaratilsa, kutish uzoqroq tuyuladi.

cards.ex: We'll just have to wait and see what happens with the new policy.
cards.exUz: Yangi siyosat bilan nima bo'lishini kutishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Nima bo'lishini kutib turish.

cards.ex: He flew off the handle when he saw the damage to his car.
cards.exUz: U mashinasiga zarar yetganini ko'rganda jahl otiga mindi.
cards.uzDef: Tez va kutilmaganda juda g'azablanish.

cards.ex: Don't expect immediate results; just give it time.
cards.exUz: Darhol natijalarni kutmang; shunchaki vaqt bering.
cards.uzDef: Nima bo'lishini ko'rish uchun biroz vaqt berish.

cards.ex: I had to grit my teeth and finish the project, even though I hated it.
cards.exUz: Men loyihani yomon ko'rsam ham, tishimni tishga qo'yib tugatishim kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir yoqimsizga sabr bilan chidash.

cards.ex: His anger was a slow burn; it built up over several days.
cards.exUz: Uning g'azabi asta-sekin kuchaydi; u bir necha kun davomida yig'ilib bordi.
cards.uzDef: Asta-sekin kuchayadigan g'azab.

cards.ex: When I feel myself getting angry, I count to ten to calm down.
cards.exUz: G'azablanayotganimni his qilsam, tinchlanish uchun o'ngacha sanayman.
cards.uzDef: G'azabni nazorat qilish uchun sekin sanash.

cards.ex: He tends to lose his temper when he's under pressure.
cards.exUz: U bosim ostida qolganda jahli chiqishga moyil.
cards.uzDef: G'azabni nazorat qilishni yo'qotish.

cards.ex: You'll understand in the fullness of time.
cards.exUz: Vaqti kelib tushunasiz.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda, kerakli vaqtda.

cards.ex: They jumped the gun and announced the news before it was confirmed.
cards.exUz: Ular shoshilinch qaror qabul qilib, yangilikni tasdiqlanmasdan e'lon qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqtidan oldin yoki shoshilinch harakat qilish.

cards.ex: He has a short fuse, so be careful what you say to him.
cards.exUz: Uning tezda jahli chiqadi, shuning uchun unga nima deyishingizga e'tibor bering.
cards.uzDef: Tezda g'azablanadigan odam.

cards.ex: It's important to remain calm in an emergency situation.
cards.exUz: Favqulodda vaziyatda xotirjam qolish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Xotirjam va asabiylashmasdan qolish.
